title: Fema / RBI | All you wanted to know about NBFCs – RBI FAQs
description: The issue concerns regulatory burden on smaller NBFCs without systemic risk exposure. The RBI introduced exemption for such entities under “Unregistered Type I NBFCs.” The key takeaway is that low-risk NBFCs may operate without registration subject to strict conditions.The post All you wanted to know about NBFCs – RBI FAQs appeared first on TaxGuru.
